description_en: Queries the details of a directory
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-directories --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --directory-type SIMPLE --directory-status REGISTERED --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --directory-id cn-hangzhou+dir-gx2x1dhsmu52rd0000 --status REGISTERED --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDirectories

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The directory status. This parameter is the same as `Status`
parameters.name: directory_status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. For more information about paging, see the NextToken parameter
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The directory IDs. You can specify one or more directory IDs
parameters.help_zh: 目录ID。可设置一个或多个
parameters.name: directory_id
